zones.name: Zephras Isle
zones.notes: Skyborne starting experience with an elemental skybound theme. Official material identifies Windshapers, the High Order, and the Al'aketh as groups involved in the island's crisis; exact NPC records remain pending.

quest_coverage.known_scope: Levels 1-12 starting experience with new quests; exact quest records pending.

npc_coverage.known_scope: New NPCs and faction/story groups are confirmed; individual NPC identities and functions require source-backed records.

zones.name: Riverglades
zones.notes: New frontier region linked to surrounding regions. Official material describes Powderfuse Port, Gnoll camps, Ogre threats, Powderfuse Goblins, Twilight's Hammer, and Brotherhood of the Horse.

quest_coverage.known_scope: More than 150 new quests in the mid-30s to mid-40s journey; exact quest-by-quest records pending.

npc_coverage.known_scope: Named groups and Powderfuse Port are source-backed; individual NPC names, types, and quest relationships pending.

zones.name: Mount Hyjal
zones.notes: Expanded setting following the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Official material describes Darkwhisper Gorge, emerging factions, new alliances, and world content; exact zone level band and NPC roster remain pending.

quest_coverage.known_scope: New story and quests are confirmed within the broader level 1-60 expansion; exact quest records pending.

npc_coverage.known_scope: Faction and character details require individual source-backed NPC records.

zones.name: Shen'dralas
zones.notes: New adventure region south of Desolace, tied to the Shen'dralar, Eldre'Thalas, Dire Maul, and centaur tribes.

quest_coverage.known_scope: New quests and story content are confirmed; exact quest records pending.

npc_coverage.known_scope: Individual NPC identities and relationships require source-backed records.

record_schema.name: display name
record_schema.type: zone | starting_zone | dungeon | raid | battleground | subzone | unknown
record_schema.content_hooks: source-backed topics, factions, locations, or systems associated with the zone
record_schema.quest_coverage: aggregate coverage status; not a substitute for individual quest records
record_schema.npc_coverage: aggregate coverage status; not a substitute for individual NPC records

data_rules: Do not infer exact boundaries, coordinates, flight paths, quest IDs, quest rewards, or spawn locations without a source.
Use separate dungeon and raid entities for instanced content even when the location is also represented as a zone.
Aggregate coverage fields describe research scope and must not be presented as individual quest or NPC records.
